baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَتَاعًا and the coordinated recipients لَكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَامِكُمْ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated lām distributes one usable and enjoyable benefit to the human plural and to livestock possessed by them, placing both recipient classes inside one field of provision.

activation_trace.role: Usable and enjoyable benefit supplies the common predicate distributed to both recipients.
Literal livestock fixes the second recipient as grazing domestic animals rather than an abstract blessing.

changed_reading.before: A bare notice of enjoyment or benefit.
changed_reading.after: One field of concrete benefit is expressly shared by humans and their livestock.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The needs-oriented branch of مَتَاعًا, governed by the two recipient phrases.
baseline_models.mechanism: Matāʿ is not only pleasure but stock, equipment, food, or any means by which a need is met; the paired lām phrases make it provision that carries both households and herds through their requirements.

activation_trace.role: A thing used for needs and subsistence recasts enjoyment as practical provisioning.
Livestock make food, water, and maintenance needs materially salient.

changed_reading.before: Pleasure granted to two recipient groups.
changed_reading.after: Usable means of subsistence and need-fulfilment for people and livestock.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَتَاعًا through its branch of keeping someone able to benefit for an extended span.
baseline_models.mechanism: The provision can be heard as maintained access rather than outright permanent possession: humans and their animals are kept in benefit for a span whose endpoint is not stated in the focus fragment.

activation_trace.role: Extended preservation for enjoyment introduces tenure and a latent endpoint into the benefit.
The livestock recipient keeps this tenure tied to bodily maintenance rather than abstraction.

changed_reading.after: A maintained opportunity to benefit, shared with livestock and implicitly held for some span.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier contest over lordship distinguishes the provider who nurtures and completes from the beneficiary who receives. Pharaoh's transgressive claim to highest lordship makes the focus's لَكُمْ sound like granted use under a superior provisioning agency, not self-originating sovereignty; even أَنْعَامِكُمْ names only subordinate possession.

activation_trace.role: Benefit names what the addressed recipients receive rather than what they originate.
Owned livestock supplies a real but nested level of human possession.
Exceeding the limit in disobedience marks absolute self-exaltation as a misuse of rank.
Nurturing, repairing, and completing supplies the functional provider role behind the benefit.
Lordship, ownership, and sovereignty identify the title Pharaoh wrongly claims for himself.
Exaltation as greatness and tyranny sharpens the contrast between receiving benefit and claiming supremacy.

structural_cues: 79:17-24 moves from an invitation toward 'your Lord' to Pharaoh's 'I am your highest lord,' with transgression framing the counterclaim.
79:27-33 then attributes environmental preparation before addressing its yield to 'you' and 'your livestock.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies contested lordship, nurture, transgression, and beneficiary grammar; I infer an agency hierarchy in which لكم grants use without making the users sovereign providers. A live alternative is that لكم marks benefit only and carries no political correction.

changed_reading.before: The provision is simply yours and your livestock's.
changed_reading.after: You and your livestock are beneficiaries with real but subordinate possession, not sovereign originators of the provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ordered construction, completion, resource emergence, water delivery, pasture, and stabilizing sequence turns matāʿ from a pile of goods into the operating yield of a prepared environment. Humans and livestock are terminal beneficiaries of one sky-earth-water-pasture support system.

activation_trace.role: Needs-serving equipment lets the whole prepared environment function as provision rather than merely contain provisions.
Livestock identify a bodily and ecological endpoint of the system's output.
Building by joining parts supplies the image of an assembled environmental architecture.
Straightness and completion make the architecture a functioning whole rather than an accidental collection.
Bringing something out of concealment models resource production from the prepared earth.
Water conveyed by watering or pouring supplies the system's delivery channel.
Pasture and grazing convert earth and water into direct animal sustenance.
Fixity and rooted stability make sustained habitation and provision possible.

structural_cues: 79:27-32 is an ordered build sequence: sky, proportion, night and daylight, earth spreading, resource emergence, and mountain anchoring immediately precede 79:33.
The coordinated third-person feminine suffixes bind the operations into one environment, while the two lām phrases in 79:33 distribute its yield.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assembled, completed, productive, watered, grazable, and stabilized elements; I supply the arrow that these interlock as one life-support system and that accusative متاعا names its yield. The live alternative is a simpler purpose clause listing independent gifts.

changed_reading.before: Discrete useful goods are supplied to people and livestock.
changed_reading.after: The prepared environment itself operates as a coordinated provisioning apparatus for both.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pasture makes livestock direct consumers of the earth's output, while the same root's pastoral-care branch makes them dependents under human keeping. Because the focus says 'for you and for your livestock,' human and animal benefit can form a relay rather than two unrelated allocations: pasture sustains herds, herds sustain households, and keepers preserve the relation.

activation_trace.role: Shared usable benefit permits a relational rather than merely parallel distribution.
Literal owned livestock occupy the hinge between environmental output and human livelihood.
Grazing and pasture provide the direct feed link to the livestock recipient.
The guardian and flock-care image adds responsibility and dependence to the pastoral link.

structural_cues: 79:31 names the earth's water and pasture immediately before 79:33 names humans and livestock.
The second beneficiary is both coordinated with لكم and possessively nested within it as أنعامكم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pasture, pastoral care, shared benefit, and 'your livestock'; I infer a feed-and-care relay in which animal benefit mediates human benefit and ownership entails keeping. The live alternative is strictly parallel allocation with no stewardship implication.

changed_reading.before: Humans and livestock receive two parallel shares of benefit.
changed_reading.after: Benefit circulates through a shared pastoral ecology in which livestock are direct recipients, human livelihood mediators, and cared-for dependents.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus initially places humans and livestock under one material-benefit predicate. The later fork between transgression and preferential choice of lower life, on one side, and restraining the self from desire, on the other, makes human matāʿ an ethically governed use: creaturely need is shared, but humans can absolutize or regulate enjoyment.

activation_trace.role: Usable enjoyment supplies the morally neutral material whose handling is later differentiated.
Livestock keep bodily appetite and creaturely maintenance visible beside the human recipient.
Crossing the limit in disobedience supplies the excess condition under which provision becomes morally disordered.
Choosing one thing over another turns attachment to lower life into an active preference, not passive use.
The lower or worldly sphere locates the preferred benefit within a nonfinal horizon.
Checking and restraining action supplies the counter-operation to unbounded consumption.
The self's inward awareness supplies the human capacity to govern its relation to provision.
Inclination of the self names appetite's pull toward making enjoyment its ruling end.

structural_cues: 79:37-41 forms an explicit outcome bifurcation around transgression and preference versus fear and self-restraint.
79:33 coordinates human and animal beneficiaries, but 79:38-40 addresses only the human as capable of preference and restraint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shared creaturely benefit and a later human choice-restraint contrast; I infer that the animal recipient calibrates bodily need while the human recipient bears responsibility for appetite. The alternative is that the livestock clause is purely economic and carries no moral comparison.

changed_reading.before: People and livestock alike are invited to consume a shared benefit.
changed_reading.after: Human use remains creaturely but becomes an ethical test: provision may be enjoyed without being preferred as the ultimate good, because desire can be restrained.

context_deltas.mechanism: The lower life is itself described through a benefit-bearing branch, yet it has an endpoint and is retrospectively compressed to an evening or its daylight. This strongly activates matāʿ as maintained enjoyment to a term: the provision is real use and sustenance, but not permanent tenure.

activation_trace.role: Being kept in enjoyment for an extended span supplies the focus model of time-bounded tenure.
Life as benefit and good directly links worldly living to the focus's usable enjoyment.
The lower world bounds that life-benefit to the proximate sphere rather than the final one.
The limit at which a thing ends supplies the explicit terminal horizon for the maintained benefit.
Staying in a place supplies the duration that the final comparison radically compresses.
Evening time gives one short measure for the apparently extended worldly stay.
The extension of morning daylight gives the paired short measure that closes the duration image.

structural_cues: 79:34 immediately interrupts the provisioning sequence with the arrival of the overwhelming event.
The final ayah retrospectively reduces the perceived stay to an evening or its daylight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lower life as benefit, an endpoint, and an extremely compressed remembered stay; I infer that the B007 term latent in متاعا is this worldly tenure. The alternative is only a thematic contrast between provision and judgment, without a lease-like nuance in the focus noun.

changed_reading.before: Provision may be maintained for an unspecified span.
changed_reading.after: The earth is a real but terminal usufruct: permission and means to benefit for a brief tenure, not permanent possession.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the focus, two opposed outcomes are each named as al-maʾwā, a place to which one joins for shelter. Against that repeated destination formula, matāʿ in its needs-serving branch becomes equipment for the present passage rather than the abode itself; utility and refuge are categorically distinct.

activation_trace.role: Needs-serving goods supply the functional category of means rather than destination.
Fiercely blazing fire supplies one final destination against which ordinary provision cannot shelter.
Joining a gathering place that gives refuge defines the destination category.
A garden screened by vegetation supplies the opposed sheltered destination.
The repeated refuge image makes final abode, not present utility, the decisive endpoint.

structural_cues: 79:39 and 79:41 repeat the same predicate frame, فإن ... هي المأوى, around opposite outcomes.
The provision of 79:33 stands before the catastrophe and the outcome bifurcation rather than inside either final-abode clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies present needs-serving goods and repeated final-refuge formulas; I infer a means-versus-abode distinction and a passage between them. A live alternative is that the two sections are merely successive topics and do not impose this functional contrast on متاعا.

changed_reading.before: Matāʿ is useful material that meets present needs.
changed_reading.after: Matāʿ is provision for the passage but cannot be mistaken for the refuge or final abode.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the form-distant 'go away with or dispense with a thing' branch of م ت ع and lets the opening extraction sequence point toward loss. It remains anchored in the focus's own branch inventory and is bounded by the final short stay. Downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory undertone of severability, never as the direct translation of متاعا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مَتَاعًا through root م ت ع branch B009, with its recipient grammar marking what is presently held in use.

activation_trace.role: Going away with or dispensing with a thing makes the provision semantically capable of severance.
Uprooting something from its place supplies the opening image of decisive removal.
Swift pulling and extraction intensify the possibility that present access can be withdrawn.
The retrospectively brief stay gives withdrawal a terminal horizon rather than making it arbitrary.

changed_reading.before: Provision is held, used, and presumed to remain available.
changed_reading.after: The same provision carries a faint undertone of eventual severance: what sustains present life can be taken away or left behind when tenure closes.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is highly surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping from ء ث ر to ث و ر and its bull branch; that image is not the lexical meaning of آثر. It remains traceable because the authorized split branch lands directly on the focus's literal livestock recipient and changes the human-animal relation. Downstream prose must label it a speculative branch echo, not morphology or translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The juxtaposed human and livestock recipients in لَكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَامِكُمْ.

activation_trace.role: Enjoyable benefit supplies the object around which human and animal modes of use can converge.
Literal livestock provides the focus anchor for the later bovine branch echo.
The split mapping's bull image creates an animal echo inside the act of preferring worldly life.

changed_reading.before: Humans and livestock share provision while remaining conceptually distinct recipients.
changed_reading.after: As a speculative echo, preferring worldly enjoyment can collapse the human recipient toward the bovine one, making ungoverned preference look like mere animal consumption.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because مقام, النفس, and نهى carry nearer contextual senses than subsistence, life-sustaining water, and sufficiency that ends further seeking. It remains anchored to the focus's needs-serving matāʿ and coherently links support, enoughness, and restrained desire. Downstream prose should qualify it as an exploratory conceptual resonance, not assign those remote branch senses directly to the contextual words.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مَتَاعًا as a thing used to meet needs, not only to maximize pleasure.

activation_trace.role: Needs-serving provision supplies the focus anchor for an enoughness model.
Support, livelihood, and subsistence frame provision as what keeps life standing.
Water by which life is maintained recalls the preceding water supply as sufficient bodily support.
Sufficiency that ends the search for more supplies a stopping rule for consumption.
The self's inclination supplies the pressure that turns enough provision into open-ended appetite.

changed_reading.before: Provision invites beneficial use and enjoyment without specifying a stopping point.
changed_reading.after: Provision can be heard as enough to uphold life, while ethical desire must recognize where need ends and accumulation begins.

strongest_changes: The creation sequence turns matāʿ from discrete goods into the operating yield of a constructed, watered, grazable, and stabilized environment.
The ending turns extended benefit into bounded usufruct and distinguishes present means from final refuge.
The shared human-livestock benefit becomes an ethical calibration: bodily need is common, while preference and restraint make human use answerable.
The Pharaoh sequence revises 'for you' from sovereign ownership toward beneficiary access under a nurturing provider.
summary.what_was_special: The focus is a compact hinge: its two lexical roots and two coordinated beneficiaries can summarize the whole environmental build behind it, then be reopened by the whole-surah judgment sequence into questions of tenure, appetite, stewardship, possession, and destination. The packet's split and remote branches also preserved odd but traceable animalization, severability, and enoughness readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact syntactic force of accusative متاعا could support purpose, result, summary, or a looser concluding relation; the system reading depends partly on that inference.
The coordination of humans and livestock securely marks shared benefit, but pastoral mediation and moral comparison are activated readings rather than necessary grammar.
The beneficiary-versus-sovereign and means-versus-refuge models depend on whole-surah sequencing rather than direct lexical contrasts inside 79:33.
The B009 severance, split-mapped bull, and sufficiency stop-rule readings should remain exploratory and explicitly qualified.
